title: Balance Bands for ClearPath Late Fees
content:
How the late-fee rate applies to the unpaid balance of a ClearPath Managed IT Services invoice follows the balance band rule. The unpaid balance is the invoice's balance as it stood at the end of the day before the assessment day, late-fee lines excluded.

1. An unpaid balance of 5000 USD or more is charged the rate on the first 1000 USD and half the rate on the part from 1000 up to 5000 USD, nothing on the part above.
2. A balance of 1000 up to 5000 USD is charged the rate on the first 1000 USD and half the rate on the rest.
3. A smaller balance is charged the rate on the whole balance.

**Worked figures at a rate of 1.5 percent (hypothetical balances).**

| Unpaid balance | Charged | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 1.5 percent of 800.00 | 12.00 |
| 1000.00 | 1.5 percent of 1000.00, half rate on nothing | 15.00 |
| 3000.00 | 1.5 percent of 1000.00 and 0.75 percent of 2000.00 | 15.00 plus 15.00, 30.00 |
| 5000.00 | 1.5 percent of 1000.00 and 0.75 percent of 4000.00 | 45.00 |
| 8000.00 | the same as at 5000.00; nothing on the 3000.00 above | 45.00 |
